title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo | TechCrunch
summary: A memo circulated earlier this year claimed that technology executive Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to multiple media reports.
